The awaiting payment stage of the simulated order
The processing stage with payment detected
The revealed stage completing the simulated order
stepInstructions: Open the practice studio and start the order lifecycle scenario. The simulation cannot create transactions.
The order starts at awaiting payment: the commit address is funded by exactly one payment for the quoted total.
After payment detection the order moves to processing: the service funds the commit and prepares the reveal.
Revealed: the inscription exists on chain. In the live app the portfolio view shows it once indexes catch up.
